# APEX Governance And Planning

- Treat governance constraints as evidence-bound inputs, not assumptions.
- Record unavailable policy evidence as a blocker or explicit uncertainty.
- Bind cost, resilience, security, and naming decisions to the selected project and environment.
- Keep implementation plans track-neutral until the kernel selects Bicep or Terraform generation.
- Do not query, exempt, assign, or deploy Azure resources directly from planning guidance.
